title: Semantic Context Forests for Learning-Based Knee Cartilage Segmentation in 3D MR Images
abstract: arXiv:1307.2965v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The automatic segmentation of human knee cartilage from 3D MR images is a useful yet challenging task due to the thin sheet structure of the cartilage with diffuse boundaries and inhomogeneous intensities. In this paper, we present an iterative multi-class learning method to segment the femoral, tibial and patellar cartilage simultaneously, which effectively exploits the spatial contextual constraints between bone and cartilage, and also between different cartilages. First, based on the fact that the cartilage grows in only certain area of the corresponding bone surface, we extract the distance features of not only to the surface of the bone, but more informatively, to the densely registered anatomical landmarks on the bone surface. Second, we introduce a set of iterative discriminative classifiers that at each iteration, probability comparison features are constructed from the class confidence maps derived by previously learned

translated_title: 用于三维磁共振图像中基于学习的膝关节软骨分割的语义上下文森林
translated_abstract: 从三维磁共振图像中自动分割人体膝关节软骨是一项有用且具有挑战性的任务，因为软骨呈薄层结构、边界弥散且强度不均匀。本文提出了一种迭代式多类别学习方法，可同时分割股骨、胫骨和髌骨软骨，该方法有效利用了骨骼与软骨之间以及不同软骨之间的空间上下文约束。首先，基于软骨仅生长于相应骨表面特定区域这一事实，我们不仅提取到骨表面的距离特征，更有意义的是，还提取到骨表面上密集配准的解剖标志点的距离特征。其次，我们引入了一组迭代式判别分类器，在每次迭代中，由先前学习得到的分类器所导出的类别置信度图构建概率比较特征……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于语义上下文森林的迭代多类学习方法，通过利用骨与软骨间的空间上下文约束以及解剖标志点距离特征，实现三维MR图像中股骨、胫骨和髌骨软骨的同时自动分割。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an iterative multi-class learning method based on semantic context forests, which simultaneously segments femoral, tibial, and patellar cartilage in 3D MR images by exploiting spatial contextual constraints between bone and cartilage and distance features to densely registered anatomical landmarks.
